newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO asset management posts 39 percecent rise.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO asset management posts 39 percecent rise.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Tuesday the value of funds managed by its asset management arm rose 39 percent to 117 billion guilders ($64 billion) at the end of 1996 from 84 billion at the end of 1995.

The bank said 46 percent of this was invested through its investment funds, 38 percent took the form of discretionary fund management on behalf of institutions while 16 percent comprised discretionary fund management for individuals.
ABN AMRO said the growth of total assets under its management was fuelled by strong investment results and an increase in the number of new portfolio management mandates.

The bank's asset management network was expanded last year through the acquisitions of Chicago Corp. in the U.S., Carrington Pembroke Ltd in London and the remaining 50 percent of Banco Fonder AB in Sweden. ($1=1.832 Guilder)
